question: Can the strong Goldbach conjecture be proved: every even integer n >= 4 is the sum of two primes?

contract.ambient_object: Integers Z with the standard set of positive primes P.
contract.coefficient_domain: Integer arithmetic over Z; primality means positive integer greater than 1 with exactly two positive divisors.
contract.quantifiers: For all n in Z, n >= 4 and n congruent to 0 mod 2; there exist p,q in P.
contract.equality_semantics: Literal equality in Z: n = p + q.

claims.statement: For every integer n >= 4, if n is even, then there exist primes p and q such that n = p + q.
claims.scope: Strong (binary) Goldbach conjecture, all even integers n >= 4, unconditional.

checks.target: Definitions, domains, quantifiers, and equality semantics are coherent.
checks.falsifier: Any undefined object, illegal quantifier, or mismatch between positive primes and integer equality.
checks.result: The statement is well-defined over Z with standard positive primes and literal equality.

checks.target: A derivation gives a positive Goldbach representation count for every even n >= 4.
checks.falsifier: An unproved uniform error bound, parity-barrier step, average-to-pointwise inference, circular assumption, or uncovered range remains.
checks.coverage: Universal claim; analytic tail and finite initial range must overlap.
checks.result: 小d正幂端点及Maynard增长-a相位已闭合；Li programmable权的(q,N)=1可逐因子传播，Lichtman Prop5.2据此覆盖nu<alpha/2的部分大d HB盒。平衡rough triple-divisor盒的Prop11.1模数指数有正裕量，但完整uniform路由仍缺Lemmas8.9/13.9/19.2、Props7.3/10.1及小M处理；Prop8.3的BFI互素传播仍是首要解析缺口。最终奇偶桥梁和其余Li数值端点也未闭合。

checks.target: Search for an even n without a prime-pair representation.
checks.falsifier: One even n >= 4 with no primes p,q satisfying n=p+q.
checks.coverage: Local independent exhaustive search through 2,000,000; published computation through 4×10^18 assessed separately.
checks.result: No counterexample through 2,000,000 locally and through 4×10^18 in the published computation; coverage is finite and does not prove the universal claim.

checks.target: Proposed strengthening: after sieving reflected complements through floor(N^(1/3)), prime survivors outnumber semiprime survivors for every even N>=4.
checks.falsifier: One even N with semiprime survivors at least as numerous as prime survivors.
checks.result: The strengthening is false at N=68: prime survivors=2 and semiprime survivors=3.

checks.target: Pointwise log(2) constant separation: a deep-rough lower bound for T(N) and semiprime upper bound for S(N) leave a uniform positive remainder P(N).
checks.falsifier: Either bound is average-only, ineffective, loses at least the 1-log(2) constant margin, or assumes a parity-sensitive prime correlation equivalent to the target.
checks.coverage: Analytic tail for every sufficiently large even N; finite prefix handled separately.
checks.result: 最弱正向桥梁已精确化为P_N=(T_N-C_N)/2：有T_N>=L_N后只需C_N<L_N，特别是T_N>0且C_N<=0足够。效率比u/ell<2.442695含统一余量也足够，但当前theta=19101/32000在立方根筛深只给s=1.79071875<2，一次Buchstab显示预算为-6.377541；无权主角色负号尚未提升到fixed-N反射素数相关。

checks.target: Proxy propagation claim: every bottom-1% normalized count in 10,000..100,000 has at least half of its twenty nearest even neighbors in the bottom 10%.
checks.falsifier: One bottom-1% point whose bottom-10% neighbor fraction is below one half.
checks.result: The proxy fails at N=10484: it is bottom 1% while none of the twenty nearest even neighbors is bottom 10%; lag-2 correlation is about 0.114.

checks.target: Central trilinear dispersion core after Vaughan/Heath-Brown decomposition of the deep semiprime correction.
checks.falsifier: The proposed estimate is average-only in N, loses the main term on any point of C_{1/2}, requires an unavailable general distribution level, or uses absolute values that exhaust the constant margin.
checks.coverage: All fixed even N above an effective threshold; parameters 1/3<u<1/2 and 1/2-u<=alpha<=(1-u)/2 after removing standard nonbalanced regions.
checks.result: Exact decomposition removes prime powers, small p, shrinking endpoint layers, and nonbalanced Type I/II regions. The residual core C_{1/2} is nonempty for every 1/3<u<1/2; one Cauchy-Schwarz plus the classical large sieve, and even an optimistic 4/7 level, does not give a summable pointwise saving there.

checks.target: Two-sided symmetric switching and quotient-weight dispersion bridge for the fixed-N reflected-prime sequence.
checks.falsifier: Direction weights are not genuinely distinct, quotient-dependent weights fall outside cited distribution theorems, the Type-II core retains full factor-band projection, or any invoked parity-breaking theorem has unverified hypotheses.
checks.coverage: Every fixed even N above an effective threshold; all u in [1/3,1/2] and all switched quotient-weight blocks.
checks.result: The symmetric identity and first-layer bound ell*m<=sqrt(N) are valid, but all admissible direction weights equal C_z/2 pointwise. Expanding the quotient weight creates C_sym with full u-projection; FI (R),(B), Ford-Maynard wide Type I/II, and SD are unproved for a_N.

checks.target: Fixed-N spectral/Kloosterman closure of the quotient-weight dispersion bridge, including the rough Titchmarsh interface.
checks.falsifier: The actual spectral modulus includes quotient factors up to N^(3/4), coefficients fail separation or factorability hypotheses, zero-frequency/diagonal terms exhaust the margin, only an average-in-N result is obtained, or the deep shell has lower-sieve parameter at most 2.
checks.coverage: All fixed even N above an effective threshold; every dyadic block with kappa in [1/2,3/4], including gcd-degenerate layers and the shell N^(1/4-epsilon)<ell<=N^(1/3).
checks.result: W049证明e(ah/[nq])保留相位可用Fourier-inert权送入Lemma18.5，且排除错误删除centered坏模数主项与普通角色大筛路线；programmable支撑绕行只闭合一部分HB盒。当前首个不可引用的估计是Prop8.3 BFI分支中(q,N)=1随色散传播，或等价的有效尺度R而非delta R的progression-sensitive Lemma18.5。

checks.target: Exact or uniformly controlled separable factorization of the real switching quotient weights, followed by a fixed-N spectral closure of every central Type-II block.
checks.falsifier: The exact aggregation fails under necessary labels, the staircase remainder is not o(N/log^2 N) in the actual prime-weighted norm, the terminal quotient coefficient remains coupled, an invoked theorem only performs a reduction or requires q-independence, or the modulus budget forces a missing factor above N^(1/66).
checks.coverage: All fixed sufficiently large even N; complete switching label sum, every dyadic central block, u in [1/3,1/2], and all terminal roughness factors through z=floor(N^(1/3)).
checks.result: Minimum-prime-factor uniqueness exactly aggregates the unweighted first switching labels, and multiplicative staircases have polylog rank with divisor-type L2 norms. But Vaughan/HB creates a second terminal quotient weight v_((N-ab)/d); no audited theorem closes it. In addition, the formal Fouvry-Radziwill thin layer does not literally satisfy its |shift|<=X hypothesis on blocks with N>CAB. Expanding the rough endpoint changes r to rt, while the 17/33 window above r~N^(1/2) allows only t<=N^(1/66+o(1)).

checks.target: One-sided upper-bound sieve closure of the separable near-balanced semiprime-reflection layer with a constant compatible with the Goldbach subtraction.
checks.falsifier: The available convolution theorem fails the fixed large-shift hypothesis, does not control every squarefree Rosser modulus, the beta-sieve parity constant exceeds the slice's geometric main mass by a fixed amount, or remaining bands would need an upper bound below their own expected main term.
checks.coverage: Every sufficiently large fixed even N; unordered prime factors with 55/112<log(a)/log(N)<=1/2 and N/2<=ab<=N-2, including local factors, small reflected primes, endpoints, diagonal, and all sieve moduli through the claimed level.
checks.result: The one-sided sieve correctly removes the terminal quotient weight and has dimension one. Formally combining a level N^(1-u) with beta-sieve constants gives the thin-layer bound [4/57+2 log(57/55)]M(N)=0.14161...M(N), versus true geometric mass 0.03572...M(N). This is too loose for BL2, and Fouvry-Radziwill as stated also requires |shift|<=X, which fails for N>CAB blocks; Li 2024 only supplies a specialized near-N large-shift interface.

checks.target: Signed Chen/Buchstab switching with a genuine large-shift distribution input that covers the full semiprime hyperbola and separates prime from strict-semiprime reflections.
checks.falsifier: Li's prime-product boxes cover only ab=N(1-o(1)) under direct mapping, modified sieve weights fail the upstream theorem, negative terms have lower-sieve parameter at most 2, local normalizations differ, the argument proves only prime+P2, or any uncovered positive-measure (u,t) region remains.
checks.coverage: Every fixed sufficiently large even N; t=ab/N in [1/2,1], u in [1/3,1/2], all three switching layers, every well-factorable branch, degenerate factors dividing N, small reflected primes, and common Goldbach normalization.
checks.result: The three-step Buchstab identity and +,-,+,- sieve directions are exact, and a conditional continuous F/f functional is available. Direct application of Li Lemma 2.2 only covers ab in (N/Delta^2,N], an endpoint shell of vanishing relative width; no full-hyperbola map for its modified Iwaniec weights is proved. Moreover theta=19101/32000 gives cube-root parameter s=1.79071875<2, so direct BL1 remains zero, while Li's 1.9728 conclusion still mixes P1 and P2.

checks.target: Uniform large-residue upgrade of Lichtman 2025 programmable-factorable and modified-Iwaniec-weight prime-product estimates at x=tN,a=N.
checks.falsifier: Any programmable-factorability or anatomy branch violates the uniform large-shift hypotheses, loses the 19101/32000 modulus level, retains an implied constant depending on growing a, fails coprimality/degenerate-factor control, or supplies only a prime-plus-P2 statement without pointwise P1/P2 separation.
checks.coverage: Every fixed k narrow prime-product box needed by Li-style switching, t in [1/2,1], a=N, all modulus-factorization branches and endpoint/degenerate cases.
checks.result: The compact-t bare Type-II transfer is valid with positive level margin, and Lichtman 2025 supplies the fixed-a programmable-factorable prime-product template. The printed theorem remains nonuniform in a; its proof must be rebuilt branchwise with the 2023 uniform large-shift inputs. Proposition 3.2 reaches Li level only when the residual short group has exponent at most 6697/64000. Even a successful upgrade would not yet separate prime from strict semiprime terms.

checks.target: Sequence-level uniformly programmable factorization and fixed-k prime-product distribution for modified Iwaniec weights with 0<|a|<x^(1+eta).
checks.falsifier: The actual anatomy weight cannot be decomposed at a triple satisfying the large-residue inequalities; Proposition 6.1 margins cannot pay the 8epsilon/15epsilon losses and support inflation; HB terms violate 1-bounded, Siegel-Walfisz, rough-support, one-long or two-long hypotheses; or the resulting theorem remains fixed-a.
checks.coverage: Level 19101/32000; all short-variable exponents, fixed-k narrow prime-product boxes, every modified-weight anatomy branch, t in [1/2,1], and all coprimality and boundary cases.
checks.result: The pure exponent systems are compatible: two independent explicit parameter families leave positive uniform-large-residue margins throughout the full short-variable range. The first unresolved step is sequence-level: Definition 2.4 does not authorize an arbitrary numerically admissible triple for a given modified weight. Rebuilding via Proposition 6.1 requires rho>(80/3)epsilon_u, payment of a 2rho level loss and support inflation, plus a complete fixed-k HB coefficient and Type-I/II ledger.

checks.target: Stable sequence-level anatomy factorization and fixed-k Heath-Brown closure for the uniform growing-residue modified-Iwaniec-weight estimate.
checks.falsifier: A box requires a p-dependent partition, repeated boxes break exact convolution normalization, support inflation exhausts level, merged Heath-Brown coefficients violate the stated 1-bounded class, or any anatomy/HB branch remains uncovered.
checks.coverage: Level 19101/32000; every nonempty modified-weight anatomy box, both layers of support inflation, repeated boxes, fixed-k prime-product expansions, all medium/one-long/two-long branches, and 0<|a|<x^(1+eta).
checks.result: The exponent budget is feasible and one representative can algebraically freeze a box partition after explicit support inflation. However the current proof does not establish uniform analytic inequalities for every box partition; repeated boxes require an internal multinomial normalization; and merged medium-branch Heath-Brown coefficients are generally divisor-bounded, while the growing-residue Proposition 5.2 is stated only for 1-bounded coefficients. Full anatomy coverage and the coefficient-class extension remain open.

checks.target: Complete variable-level dilation transfer for every modified-weight anatomy cell, with fixed-partition support certificates and fixed-k prime-product Heath-Brown closure.
checks.falsifier: Any proof uses the global maximum level for all anatomy boxes, lacks upper-corner or psi-boundary stability, cannot absorb D^(1+tau+epsilon), violates short-side SW/rough support, or loses the positive sieve constant after lowering the endpoint level.
checks.coverage: All r>=0 anatomy branches used in Li 2024, t in [1/2,1], a=N, anatomy-specific levels, repeated boxes, fixed k, and every medium/one-long/two-long branch.
checks.result: The fixed-order divisor-bounded growing-residue Type-II coefficient bridge is closed, including the actual HB medium branch. Exact rational witnesses refute only the stronger uniform-maximum-level reading: r=1,t1=1/5 and r=3,t_i=1/20 require lower anatomy-specific levels. The smooth u=1/500 endpoint reaches 19101/32000 with zero fixed slack, so a valid dilation transfer must lower each actual level, certify upper-corner/polyhedral partitions, and recheck the final sieve constants under that loss.

checks.target: A strict-loss variable-level x=tN,a=N transfer of Li 2024 prime-product distribution, with a certified positive sieve constant after lowering every anatomy level.
checks.falsifier: Exact-v scaling exceeds the x-based modulus level, any anatomy cell lacks a fixed upper-corner partition, re-scaled prime-product boxes violate HB Type I/II hypotheses, or interval-certified sieve constants lose the required positive margin.
checks.coverage: All t in [1/2,1], r>=0 Li anatomy branches, re-scaled fixed-k prime-product boxes, every HB branch, all level-boundary strips, and Li equations (13)-(34) with directed numerical errors.
checks.result: 已严格闭合数值节点(13),(22),(23)-(25),(28)-(31)，且(21)条件于Li(17)的H表闭合；R048纠正式(25)的增强level门条件后仍以S10/M>0.960459919194349603越线。R045则独立确认按印刷式(20)有I20>0.272302682186493>0.272301，触发数值链检查；式(19)也高目标约1.712438e-6。当前未闭合端点为14,16,19,20,33,34，另有H/h来源与variable-level/HB解析接口。

checks.target: Prove fixed-N parity reflection coherence PRC: for some fixed B,eta>0 and every sufficiently large even N, the high-frequency von Mangoldt reflection correlation relative to the primorial residue-class projection is at least -(1-eta) times its positive local main term.
checks.falsifier: An unbounded sequence of even N saturates or exceeds full negative reflection cancellation, or the proposed argument supplies only average-in-N, one-point progression, or unsigned L2 control and therefore cannot improve the trivial -N log N scale to the required -O(N) one-sided bound.
checks.coverage: Every sufficiently large even N; primorial W<=log^B N with w tending to infinity; the actual truncated von Mangoldt vector; explicit prime-power removal and the full high-frequency reflection term.
checks.result: PRC's local projection main term, explicit prime-power removal, and almost-all-N form are established, but the required every-even-N one-sided high-frequency reflection bound remains open. Trivial unitarity is -N log N while PRC needs -O(N), and a reflection-oriented pseudoprime model rules out closing it from one-point AP data alone.

evidence.summary: Independent exhaustive local verification found prime-pair witnesses for every even n from 4 through 2,000,000; finite evidence only.
Helfgott proves the ternary/weak conjecture by explicit circle-method estimates, not the binary conjecture.
Wu's double-sieve paper records the binary representation function and quantitative prime-plus-P2 results while the lower bound for two primes remains open.
Published empirical verification covers all even integers through 4×10^18, but cannot close the unbounded quantifier.
Explicit Chen theorem gives prime plus square-free P2 for N>exp(exp(32.7)); the prime-plus-prime strengthening remains open and parity-limited.
Definition and type audit fixes the ambient integers, prime domain, universal quantifiers, and literal equality semantics.
Independent analytic-route audit identifies the precise missing pointwise minor-arc bound and parity-sensitive sieve obligations.
Counterexample-first proof-gap audit lists the fatal inference errors that any candidate proof must clear.
Decisive for the explicitly finite subclaim 4<=N<=2,000,000 only: all 999,999 even inputs have a prime-pair witness.
Reflection-cover reduction and multiscale log(2) constant-separation program; proof obligation remains open.
Finite prespecified propagation proxies are refuted in 10,000..100,000; adjacent normalized correlation is about 0.114 and N=10484 has zero low-decile neighbors.
Residue-unbiased exhaustive deep-sieve census for every even N in 10,000..100,000; minimum prime fraction 170/306 at N=23678.
Fixed-seed residue-diverse sample of 3,998 even values through 2,000,000; worst semiprime/prime ratio 0.68395, near the log(2) heuristic.
The universal deep-sieve prime-majority strengthening is false: at N=68 there are 2 prime and 3 semiprime survivors.

Constructive proof attempt proves the cube-root classification, exact prime-selecting weight, Buchstab identity, log(2) constant subtraction, and finite-tail splice; the sole unresolved analytic input is the pointwise joint bridge BL1-BL2.

BL bridge refinement gives the exact exponent-band decomposition, finite-scale I_N(q) correction, endpoint budget, shallow-sieve cumulative identity, and the remaining trilinear core C_{1/2}; ordinary and optimistic 4/7 large-sieve inputs do not cover a full factor band.

Fixed-seed profile of 999 even inputs through 2,000,000 partitions the deep semiprime correction into six smaller-factor exponent bands; the first five track the geometric integrals and the highest band shows the predicted finite boundary suppression.

Li proves the pointwise Chen-type lower bound D_{1,2}(N)>=1.9728 C(N)N/log^2N using special weighted distribution exponent 19101/32000, but does not separate prime and semiprime reflections; at z=N^(1/3) the direct linear-sieve parameter remains below 2.
Symmetric ordered-factor identity, direction-weight rigidity, two-sided Buchstab switching, and the migrated quotient-weight Type-II core are derived explicitly; the SD bridge remains unproved.
R008 checks all symmetric pointwise and summed identities on 1,797,533 reflected inputs through N=10,000; finite verification does not establish the analytic bridge.

Independent theorem-applicability audit finds that FI asymptotic sieve and Ford-Maynard prime-producing criteria are conditionally sufficient but require unproved Mobius-twisted or arbitrary-coefficient Type-II estimates on the fixed-N reflected-prime sequence.
W017 derives the exact Titchmarsh interface C_z=tau-2, identifies the reduced inverse phase from Vaughan/HB congruences, and isolates the unproved structured Kloosterman quotient-weight bridge KSD.
R009 checks the gcd reduction, reduced congruence, and additive-character detector on 100,000 deterministic samples; it does not estimate the spectral off-diagonal.

Independent parameter derivation finds genuine raw Bettin-Chandee cancellation and a narrow Fouvry-Radziwill candidate window kappa<17/33, but the actual spectral modulus reaches N^(3/4) and the rough quotient weight remains coupled.

Independent source audit verifies large-shift AP and uniform Titchmarsh theorems, including Lichtman level 153/256 and ABL for Lambda(p)tau(N-p), while finding none that admits the actual q-dependent rough quotient weights.

Independent anti-circularity audit preserves q-dependent weights, fixed N, all zero-frequency and diagonal terms, and shows why generic BFI/Kuznetsov invocations would overreach their coefficient hypotheses.

W018 proves exact minimum-prime-factor label aggregation for the unweighted switching sum, separates the prime-indicator and von Mangoldt analogues, quantifies the separable Fouvry-Radziwill thin layer and the N^(1/66) terminal-factor budget, while leaving the true terminal quotient weight unresolved.

R010 verifies on a deterministic finite grid that the threshold matrix has full row rank, the minimum-prime-factor shell identity holds, all 100000 sampled double-label aggregations agree, and L_y,z never exceeds 1; this does not prove a spectral estimate.

Independent analytic route derives polylogarithmic multiplicative staircase separation and divisor-type L2 coefficient bounds, then locates failure before the Bettin-Chandee interface and the terminal-factor limit t<=N^(1/66) in the Fouvry-Radziwill modulus window.

Independent literature audit through 2026-09-03 finds no closed four- or five-linear dispersion theorem accepting the terminal quotient weight; Maynard/Lichtman allow joint weights only in reduction steps, while Yang 2026 still requires separated outer weights and inner variables.

Independent pressure audit gives growing exact-rank and singular-value lower bounds, tracks coefficient-norm and label-collision losses, and shows that unweighted low-rank error cannot control the fixed-N prime-weighted remainder.

W019 replaces the terminal Lambda expansion by a one-dimensional upper sieve for N-ab, derives the local density and the formal 55/112 thin-layer constant 4/57+2 log(57/55), and records that the literal large-shift hypothesis and the parity constant prevent closure.

R011 exactly checks the 1/112 width, 55/112 matching identity, 1/66 exponent identity, and numerically evaluates the thin-layer true mass 0.0357181, upper-sieve bound 0.141612, and excess 0.105894; arithmetic only, not a sieve theorem.

Independent route derives the dimension-one beta-sieve normalization and shows the near-balanced level would yield constant 0.14161 M(N), about 3.96 times the slice's predicted mass, so it cannot improve the sharp BL2 log(2) target.

Independent source audit verifies Fouvry-Radziwill controls 1-bounded Rosser weights only when the fixed shift satisfies |a|<=X; the present N>CX blocks are not covered. Li 2024 supplies a specialized large-shift interface near product N, not a full absolute-discrepancy theorem for the whole hyperbola.

Independent pressure audit confirms the upper-sieve normalization and thin-layer integral, while listing unresolved fixed-N large-shift, epsilon-level, squarefree-modulus, small-prime, noncoprime, endpoint, and diagonal obligations.

W020 gives an exact three-step Buchstab identity with +,-,+,- signs, a conditional F/f switching functional, and isolates two simultaneous obligations: dilation-uniform large-shift distribution and parity-sensitive separation. Direct Li boxes cover only ab=N(1-o(1)); Li's maximum level also leaves the cube-root lower sieve at s<2.

R012 checks the endpoint width of Li-style product boxes at fixed finite parameters and the formal 19101/32000 beta-sieve factor; the output explicitly warns that incompatible populations cannot be subtracted as a proof.
R013 exactly computes 3*(19101/32000)=57303/32000<2 and the level gap 2/3-19101/32000=6697/96000, showing the cube-root linear lower sieve remains nonpositive at the known level.

Independent analytic derivation supplies the four signed Buchstab terms, well-factorable constraints, conditional continuous functional, and shows the uncovered pair-volume after W019 is about 94.85 percent of the original region.

Independent source audit verifies Li Lemma 2.2's exponent-sum-one boxes and modified Iwaniec weights, identifies Lichtman reparameterization as a possible but unproved transfer, and finds no existing wide-hyperbola plus large-shift plus signed-weight black box.

Independent adversarial review validates the signed identity and functional form after revision, while preserving unresolved theorem-domain, f(s)>0, local-normalization, degeneracy, factor-two, and P1/P2 separation obligations.
W021主稿严格证明x=tN、a=N在t属于[1/2,1]时可统一嵌入Lichtman 2023的裸triply-well-factorable Type-II估计，并给出19101/32000 level的正裕量；同时定位修改Iwaniec权与uniform-a prime-product推论的未闭合义务。
R015以精确有理数核算eta与epsilon联合约束后的level裕量12793/51200000，并给出Proposition 3.2达到Li level所需的短组阈值6697/64000；该计算只审计指数，不证明筛权转移。
独立解析智能体验证compact-t尺度转移、well-factorability尺度不变性与polylog分箱框架，并定位Proposition 6.6的非一致余数常数和两长变量分支缺口。
独立反证审计纠正了eta与epsilon必须联立的量词错误，证明Proposition 3.2不能自动覆盖19101/32000，并列出修改权anatomy、互素退化和P1/P2分离的未决义务。
Lichtman 2025 Proposition 5.5与Corollary 5.6明文把programmable factorability和修改Iwaniec权推进到固定k个窄素数乘积盒，但陈述只对固定余数a成立且误差常数依赖a。
独立来源审计逐字核对Lichtman 2025 Definition 2.4、Theorem 2.5、(5.17)-(5.18)、Proposition 5.5与Corollary 5.6，记录fixed-a误差、prime-product盒及修改权anatomy调用链，并列出uniform-a移植义务。
W022主稿证明19101/32000 level下存在同时满足2025 programmable-factorability数值系统与2023 uniform-large-shift Type-II数值系统的显式三因子尺度，并把剩余障碍定位到实际修改权卷积分解与HB分支。
R016以精确有理数验证显式候选在完整短变量区间的全部数值不等式、非负端点与严格裕量；输出明确声明不认证实际筛权卷积或HB覆盖。
独立解析推导给出d=3delta/2、s=5delta/2的另一统一可行族，追踪支撑膨胀损失，并证明数值可行性不能替代Definition 2.4的存在性卷积见证。
独立压力审计复核R016并纠正HB共同区间，发现Proposition 5.2的1-bounded系数义务和Proposition 6.1参数映射rho>(80/3)epsilon_u，确认首个断点仍是实际anatomy权的卷积分解。
W023主稿精确验证rho>(80/3)epsilon_u及正level预算，同时记录固定box分区、重复box重数和HB系数类三个未闭合接口。
R017以精确参数预算验证Proposition 6.1到5.2及固定k=2的一长两长指数不等式均有正裕量；不认证序列卷积或全anatomy覆盖。
独立解析稿推出参数映射、单变量窄窗和HB三分支候选；其固定box及1-bounded闭合主张已被后续反证审计收窄。
独立来源核验逐字确认Proposition 6.1的实际greedy分组、两层support膨胀、重复box外层阶乘校正及growing-residue Proposition 5.2的1-bounded明文假设。
独立反证审计以D1=D2=x^(25/128)给出未归一化卷积重数2，并证明HB合并系数通常仅divisor-bounded；同时排除level预算的纯数值矛盾。
W024主稿证明固定阶divisor-bounded的growing-residue Proposition 5.2扩展，给出HB短侧SW/rough接口，并以精确见证排除全anatomy统一最大level的误读。

On every affine theta winner branch, s=e+D(x,y)/z and ds=-D z^-2 dz, so the z^-2 factor in Li equation (14)'s triple integral cancels exactly and reduces the term to a two-dimensional fibre integral.
R050 exact rational enumeration verifies all 12 nonempty theta winner polytopes, their full ordered-domain volume, the fibre identity at every vertex, and D>=53/206 on the actual winner regions.

Independent W050 audit accepts R049's exact geometry/Hessian directions and R050's fibre identity, endpoint orientation, and D>0 bounds; it derives the explicit primitive P(s)=q s-2b(s+1) for s>=1 and retains REVISE for the unfinished equation (14) numerical bound.

R051 sharpened the direct three-dimensional equation (14) certificate with local range/Taylor intersection and 2000 adaptive splits, but the triple interval remained about [-68.246,67.773]; this confirms that refinement without exact fibre cancellation is quantitatively unsuitable.

R052 non-rigorous fibre-reduced Gauss-Legendre diagnostics stabilize near S2/M=6.5339278 through order 256, about 1.18e-5 above Li equation (14)'s threshold; this guides the strict error target but is not a proof.

A direct fixed-N parity bridge reduces strong Goldbach to the one-sided scalar PRC inequality. The local projection main term and prime-power removal are proved, almost-all N satisfy a quantitative form, and a reflection-oriented pseudoprime model shows why one-point AP data cannot close the remaining O(N log N) to O(N) gap.

R055 exactly partitions Li equation (14)'s 12 theta winner polytopes into 28 active vertical-fibre cells and 47 rational triangles; every branch fibre volume and the total ordered-domain volume match. Its independent primitive endpoint ranges remain too wide, so only the geometry—not the numerical lower bound—is certified.

Independent audit accepts the PRC reflection decomposition, truncated singular-series main term, prime-power removal, almost-all quantifier, and reflection-oriented pseudoprime obstruction; two minor uniformity details were added to the main draft. PRC itself remains unproved.

R056 combines exact fibre geometry with a centred second-order two-dimensional Taylor enclosure. After 2000 adaptive splits it rigorously narrows Li equation (14) to 6.516134800674578668<S2/M<6.551398375323379573, a major convergence improvement but still not enough for the 6.533916 lower threshold.

decision.reason: 本轮取得可复核的局部推进：Li式(13)和纠正适用域后的式(23)-(25)均有全有理严格证书；平方根端点的小d正幂区间闭合，Maynard增长余数相位被压缩为可分离inert权，且部分大d HB盒可由逐因子互素支持覆盖。与此同时，独立全有理审计证明按Li印刷式(20)其积分严格大于0.272301，触发全数值链检查；式(14)、(16)、(19)、(33)、(34)、大d BFI互素传播及最终奇偶敏感prime-prime桥梁仍未闭合。
decision.limitations: 这些证据只认证局部积分、参数区间和条件性分布接口。Li的H/h表尚未从Wu 2008独立重算；式(20)矛盾可能来自印刷、版本或未披露端点，但在查明前不能使用该常数。R048不证明上游variable-level sieve；Maynard Proposition8.3的BFI互素传播和若干uniform-a依赖仍开。即使Li的P1+P2常数链完全修复，也仍需突破筛法奇偶障碍，才能得到每个充分大偶数的两个素数表示，并还需有限范围核验。
